pages.text: Coal infused with $(l:threats/hollow)Hollow$(/l) Frozen Breath. Burns in Thermal Heaters $(bold)four times longer than coal$(): 96,000 ticks against 24,000.$(br2)Fourteen ORSA memos explain why this should not work. It works.
